diagnosis: reports/step31_t0_contact/dz*_*.json (step-30 T0 unclean: palm vs held can at transport end; slow_all: held can pushes basket ~0.22 m); BASKET_TRANSPORT_DZ=0.175 was measured on T1's short objects and reused for T0/T7's tall cans

method.carry_evidence: per object: unexcused/unexplained robot contact in its lift/transport steps, or another tracked object displaced > 0.02 m during them
method.repair: on task-failed or contact-unclean executions, raise lift_dz/transport_dz of objects with carry evidence by 0.03 m (max 0.06 m total); manner commands unchanged; shares the 3-execution budget
method.experience: clearance_prior: per (task, object) clearance level with highest Beta(1,1) posterior of evidence-free carries in OTHER scenes' write-back rows; default 0

conditions.full: S30_WB_READ = step30 frozen pilot rows + step31 pilot rows; clearance prior + clearance repair

formal.baseline: reports/step30_manner_gen/formal/full (same scenes, same intake, same force library, v5 no clearance)

amendment_experience_loso.why: in the frozen pilot library (scenes 40/41) the evidence rate at clearance 0 was low (3/25 soup carries), so the clearance prior stayed 0 in every formal case; this condition tests whether accumulated experience moves the prior and reduces FIRST-execution failures
